g.title: legend
g.text: Saved standing condition | Selected left knee motor/afferent circuits and incoming boundary references.
Arrow: saved excitatory category. Open circle: saved inhibitory category.
Neuron colours: RG blue; PF green; motor salmon; afferent purple.
Dashed pentagons: boundary references, not additional neurons.
Edge numbers: gmax (uS). Full fields and IDs accompany each panel.
